_comment: Files in the config UI (views/, surfaces/onboarding/) that may build by hand what a shared piece does, per rule, each with a reason: special drawing a piece can't carry. Rules: StateLayer, Keys.onSpacePressed, tone-sunken, SegmentButton, onRowClicked, first-literal, restore-text. scripts/check_structure.py fails on a hit not listed here and on an entry that no longer hits; growth of this list is judged in review (docs/dev/core/shared-ui-pieces.md > When a page may own a local piece).

qml/components/views/Keybinds/BindEditor.reason: the notices strip is one sunken band of merge, issue and undo lines, not a card or an item box

qml/components/views/Monitors/MonitorCan.reason: special drawing: a draggable monitor tile on a canvas, its tint follows the drag

qml/components/views/base/WorkArea.qml.reason: the sunken well the work sits on, a surface of the work area itself
